newsitem.title: TURKEY: Kurd rebels kill Turkish soldier in clash.
newsitem.headline: Kurd rebels kill Turkish soldier in clash.

text.p: Kurdish guerrillas killed a Turkish soldier and wounded two others in a clash in the mountainous east of the country, security officials said on Tuesday.

They said the fighting took place on Monday night when troops closed in on a group of around 100 Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels who had been spotted by a military helicopter in a remote area of the province of Tunceli.

Security officials said they believed PKK fighters had died in the clash but soldiers had yet to recover their bodies. More than 21,000 people have died in 12 years of conflict between troops and the rebels, fighting for Kurdish self-rule.
